items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: And I used to call Earle Warren “Egghead”

ctx.x: They all had names for each other. But now I knew they all had names so I started naming them. And I used to call Earle Warren “Egghead” and Sweets, he always would take me to get strawberry ice cream, but I always bothered him. He said, “you always bug © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -12-
— there’s your father, go ask your father.” And I said, “no I want you to get me the strawberry ice cream.” Because he had all this money.
